summary_1line: Kumbhakarna rebukes Ravana’s poor judgment yet ultimately vows to fight Rama and destroy the enemy to console and support his brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: The gigantic Kumbhakarna stands before the grieving Ravana in his throne hall, laughing grimly as he lectures the king about his reckless decision.
Kumbhakarna, mountain-like in stature, vows to crush Rama with his bare fists while terrified courtiers look on in Ravana’s court.
Ravana sits frowning on his throne while the colossal Kumbhakarna leans forward speaking calmly, promising to march into battle and bring back Rama’s head.
